name: com.natsume777.addressteller
description: Code-first auto-assignment of Unity Addressables addresses and labels. Define rules in C# instead of ScriptableObject UI.

samples.description: Minimal example of defining address/label rules in C#.
Mirror folder hierarchy into addresses and top-level folder names into labels.
Assign groups and labels based on asset type (prefab, texture, audio, ScriptableObject).
Helper and NUnit sample for unit-testing AddressRuleBase subclasses without a live Addressables project.
